primary_control_metric: Per-training-seed return AUC over log2 label budget, normalized by log2(256)-log2(8); paired contrasts, two-sided t intervals and Holm correction over the three prespecified primary contrasts
scope: Five fresh training RNG seeds paired with five reused historical dataset splits. New evaluation seeds, not a new held-out task or wholly untouched dataset. Restored data/update/evaluation scale under the explicitly repaired temporal protocol and existing route objective. No outcome-dependent stopping or seed replacement.
timing_control: Offset1 and offset2 share the direct multi-horizon readout. Offset1 is a paired window control, not an exact reproduction of the historical recursive bridge.
method_integrity: Unchanged scientific classes, temporal adapter, route full-visibility family objective. Local timing-adapted LAPO/LAOM, not official reproductions. Matched/raw controls share trainable initialization and resources; entire baseline matrix is not parameter/FLOP matched.
